title: Connect Finance Balance Sheet v1
description: One fiscal year of the real Balance Sheet / Statement of Financial Position (finance_church_balances) -- a structurally different report from Church Report's actual-vs-budget income statement: point-in-time Assets/Liabilities/Equity account balances, one balance per account as of the report's single as-of date, with production's own Designated-Funds-as-Equity reclassification and Donor-Restricted/Without-Donor-Restriction breakdown already applied, matching what production's own Balance Sheet tab shows. Real money crosses this contract, unlike the structural-only Chart of Accounts contract. This does not carry Church Report data (finance_church_entries) -- that is a separate report and a separate contract.

asOfDate.description: The raw "As of ..." label from the import that produced this fiscal year's snapshot. Empty string for a fiscal year with nothing imported yet -- that is a normal state, not an error.

accounts.description: May legitimately be empty for a fiscal year with no imported Balance Sheet yet. Includes group/header rows (hasChildren=true) alongside leaf accounts, exactly as finance_church_balances stores them, AFTER production's own Designated-Funds-as-Equity reclassification (the '25000 Funds' branch reads classification 'Equity' here, not the raw-imported 'Liabilities') -- matching what production's own Full account detail tree shows.

assetsCents.description: Sum of ownBalanceCents for every 'Assets' account, group rows included -- production sums flatly regardless of hasChildren (confirmed 2026-09-14: real has_children=1 rows can carry a genuinely nonzero own_balance_cents).

liabilitiesCents.description: Sum of ownBalanceCents for every 'Liabilities' account, post-reclassification -- does not include the '25000 Funds' branch, which reads 'Equity' here.

equityCents.description: Sum of ownBalanceCents for every 'Equity' account, post-reclassification -- includes the '25000 Funds' branch. Always equal to equityReclass.totalEquityCents (both are computed from the same reclassified rows).

currentAssetsCents.description: The subset of assetsCents whose category path's top-level group (the segment directly under 'Assets') matches /current/i.

fixedAssetsCents.description: The subset of assetsCents whose top-level group matches /fixed/i.

otherAssetsCents.description: assetsCents minus currentAssetsCents minus fixedAssetsCents -- derived by subtraction so the three segments always add up to assetsCents by construction, never summed independently.

balancedCents.description: assetsCents - (liabilitiesCents + equityCents). Zero in a correctly balanced import; reported as-is, never hidden, when it is not.

equityReclass.description: Production's own Donor-Restricted / Without-Donor-Restriction split (computeEquityReclassification in src/api-finance.js), computed from the SAME already-reclassified rows as `accounts`/`totals` -- see this contract's producer (src/api-contracts.js) for why that specific ordering is reproduced exactly as production's real route computes it, not as a separate comment in that same file says it should be.

donorRestrictedCents.description: Sum of every breakdown bucket's cents.

unrestrictedCents.description: The residual against totalEquityCents -- never a direct sum of legacy equity lines.

purpose_time.description: Confirmed 2026-09-14: empty (0 cents) in every real fiscal year on file today -- the spec's original bucket, kept for a future account that could use it, not schema-forbidden.

unclassified.description: Real accounts in the 12000 Investment Accounts / 25000 Funds / Equity neighborhoods that do not match a known code -- e.g. a brand-new fund or investment sub-account not yet reviewed. Not counted toward either bucket until a human classifies it. Empty in every real fiscal year checked so far, but genuinely possible.

classification.description: Confirmed 2026-09-14: finance_church_balances never carries any other classification value -- unlike Church Report's finance_church_entries, which genuinely has Other Income/Other Expenses/Cost of Goods Sold beyond Income/Expenses.

categoryPath.description: Colon-joined account path, e.g. 'Assets:Current Assets:Bank Accounts:11027 Lindell Checking xx9105'. Post-reclassification for the '25000 Funds' branch, which starts with 'Equity:' here, not 'Liabilities:'.

ownBalanceCents.description: This account's own non-cumulative balance as of the report date -- never a rolled-up subtotal. NOT nullable: confirmed 2026-09-14 that finance_church_balances.own_balance_cents is never null in any real row, unlike Church Report's own_budget_cents. A hasChildren=true row is not guaranteed to be 0 -- confirmed 2026-09-14 against real production data, contrary to an unverified assumption elsewhere in this codebase.
